products.name: Microsoft Teams Governance & Lifecycle Management — Commercial
products.short_description: Establish Teams governance & lifecycle — creation control, naming/classification, ownership, expiration/retention/archival, and reporting — so collaboration scales without sprawl. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stop Teams sprawl with real governance and lifecycle control

Uncontrolled team/channel creation turns Microsoft Teams into sprawl — duplicate teams, orphaned owners, and stale data. This solution establishes Teams governance and lifecycle: a creation/request model, naming and classification policy, membership/ownership standards, expiration and retention (M365 Groups expiration + retention), archival, and reporting — so collaboration scales without chaos.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the governance model: creation control, naming/classification, ownership, expiration/retention/archival, and reporting.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (Teams + M365 Groups, admin roles, group source of truth, governance stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — set the creation/request model, apply naming + classification, set ownership standards, enable group expiration + retention + archival, and stand up governance reporting — pilot-first, each policy named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (creation controlled, naming enforced, stale teams handled) plus Best Practices for durable Teams governance.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Teams that scale without chaos — creation governed, named and classified, ownership enforced, stale teams expired or archived — collaboration under control.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Get-TeamsGovernanceInventory.ps1 — Read-only discovery/gap assessment of all Teams/M365 Groups: flags ownerless, stale, duplicate, and
    • Get-TeamsGovernanceReport.ps1 — Read-only governance & lifecycle report: creation-control status, naming/classification coverage,
    • Set-TeamsCreationNamingPolicy.ps1 — Configure M365 Groups creation control + naming policy (and optionally enable container labels) via the
    • Set-TeamsLifecyclePolicy.ps1 — Configure Teams/M365 Groups lifecycle: expiration policy, Purview retention (compliance-set duration),
    • Test-TeamsGovernanceReadiness.ps1 — Read-only validation / scope-health check of the Teams governance controls: creation control, naming,

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
